common.noOrgBody: Commercial features are managed per organization. Create your organization first, then come back to this page.

provenance.observedTip: Measured from data recorded on the platform.
provenance.modelDerivedTip: Computed by a documented formula from observed inputs.
provenance.simulatedTip: Synthetic test-fixture data; always labelled as such.
provenance.missingTip: The platform does not hold the data required for this metric.

errors.forbiddenBody: Your role does not permit this action. An organization owner or admin must perform it, or your role needs to be changed.

billing.title: Billing
billing.intro: Subscription, usage and invoices for your organization. The currently active payment provider is labelled on this page.
billing.testModeNote: Payments are processed by the sandbox provider — no real money moves.
billing.cancelDialogBody: Your plan stays active until {date}. After that the subscription is canceled and paid capabilities stop. Your data is not deleted.
billing.resumeDialogBody: The scheduled cancellation is removed and billing continues as usual.
billing.changeConfirmBody: Your organization moves to the {plan} plan ({period}) immediately. The next invoice reflects the new price.
billing.startConfirmBody: The {plan} plan ({period}) is activated for your organization now. If the plan includes a trial, it starts immediately.
billing.contactSalesTip: No self-serve price is published for this plan. Contact sales for a quote.
billing.plansDesc: Start a subscription or change plans. Upgrades and downgrades take effect immediately.
billing.usageDesc: Metered capability consumption versus your plan limits.
billing.usageResets: Counters reset every billing period (monthly plans: calendar month, yearly plans: calendar year).
billing.sandboxDesc: Simulate the provider payment webhook for the current open invoice — succeed or decline. Available only while the sandbox provider is active.
billing.noSubscriptionBody: This organization has no live subscription. Pick a plan below to start one.

insights.title: Insights
insights.intro: Executive dashboard built on observed platform data. Every metric states its provenance; missing data is never rendered as zero.
insights.filtersCropDisabled: The analytics API does not support crop filtering yet; this filter is disabled instead of being silently ignored.
insights.cropDistDesc: Crop cycles by crop label, from recorded crop history.
insights.perfDesc: Field-by-field comparison for the selected farm and period.
insights.selectFarmHint: Select a farm and a period to see performance and commercial metrics.
insights.commercialDesc: Financial figures exist only from your stated assumptions combined with measured volumes.
insights.assumptionsHint: Rendered verbatim as returned by the API.
insights.crossOrgBody: Comparing against anonymized data from other organizations is a future capability and is not available in this release.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Generate, schedule and download reports. Failed jobs show the exact server error.
reports.genDesc: PDF renders in the background; CSV and XLSX can be generated instantly.
reports.delDialogBody: The generated file is removed from the server. This cannot be undone.
reports.schedDesc: Recurring generation on a fixed interval, or clear the schedule.

developer.title: Developer
developer.intro: API keys, webhooks and request usage for the public API.
developer.keysDesc: Keys authenticate server-to-server requests. The full secret is shown once, at creation or rotation.
developer.scopesHint: At least one scope is required.
developer.secretDesc: This is the only time the full secret is shown. Store it securely before closing.
developer.rotateBody: A new secret is generated and the old one stops working immediately. The replacement is shown once.
developer.revokeBody: Requests signed with this key are rejected immediately. This cannot be undone.
developer.webhooksDesc: Receive signed events at your HTTPS endpoint. Endpoints auto-disable after 5 consecutive failed deliveries.
developer.whSecretDesc: The old secret stops verifying signatures immediately.
developer.deliveriesDesc: Most recent delivery attempts for this endpoint.
developer.usageDesc: Request counts over the last {days} days, with your plan's rate limit.
developer.apiDisabled: The public API is not enabled on the current plan.
developer.eventsDesc: Event types your endpoints can subscribe to.
developer.eventFarmUpdated: A farm's details were updated (name, boundaries, settings).
developer.eventFieldCreated: A new field was created inside a farm.
developer.eventCropCycleUpdated: A crop cycle changed (sowing, harvest or crop record).
developer.eventRecommendationGenerated: A new recommendation was generated for your fields.
developer.eventReportReady: A report finished generating and is ready to download.
developer.eventAlertRaised: An operational alert was raised (threshold crossed).
developer.eventSubscriptionUpdated: The subscription or plan status changed.
developer.whDeleteBody: The endpoint stops receiving events immediately. This cannot be undone.

entitlement.limitBody: Your current plan cannot perform this action. Upgrade to unlock it.
